title: When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM
abstract: arXiv:2610.33583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score--balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. translated_title: 当最弱的语言不断变动时：面向多语言 BabyLM 的 ARMOR-DP
translated_abstract: 多语言 BabyLM 系统通常采用固定的语言采样比例，尽管在训练过程中最弱的语言可能会发生变化。我们提出了 ARMOR-DP，一个模块化框架，它能够诊断源于表示、暴露量、模型容量和目标函数压力的不平衡问题，并利用各语言的验证损失来更新采样策略。受控实验表明，相同的字符预算会给中文带来严重的表示伪影；字节级编码消除了其中大部分伪影，而静态的中文保护策略随后可能使英语成为最弱的语言。动态控制器能够跟踪这些转变，并取得比固定保护更好的分数—平衡权衡。在官方评测中，采用课程动态机制的检查点在性能上优于与之匹配的静态中文保护基线，同时使用的中文训练轮次更少；扩大模型容量则产生了最强的内部 ARMOR-DP 系统。这些结果支持一个简单的结论：多语言弱势……
tldr: 提出 ARMOR-DP 动态采样框架，利用各语言验证损失实时调整多语言 BabyLM 训练中的语言采样比例，应对“最弱语言”随训练动态变化的问题，在减少中文训练轮次的情况下取得了优于静态保护策略的性能与语言平衡权衡。
en_tdlr: ARMOR-DP is a modular framework that dynamically updates language sampling proportions using per-language validation loss, tracking the shifting identity of the weakest language in multilingual BabyLM training and achieving a better score-balance tradeoff than static language protection.
